turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out. Orders typically leave the warehouse within 2 business days when they don’t contain a pre-order or custom piece.

Once shipped:

US and Canada Priority Shipping: 2–7 business days
International shipping: 15–20 business days

Business days exclude weekends and public holidays. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time, and these estimates aren’t guaranteed. Pre-order and custom items follow their own lead times and ship together with the rest of the order.

turns.q: How do I contact your support team if I have an issue with an order?
turns.replyTail:
For an order issue, email us at support@evryjewels.com and include:

Your order number
A clear photo of everything you received, when relevant
A description of the issue and any other helpful details

This helps us review your request more quickly 💖
